text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Immediately after the Oka Sho, faced with 
an overwhelming roar of cheers directed 
right at her, Mejiro Dober finds her past 
trauma resurfacing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aware of her trembling body, Mejiro Dober 
desperately tries to psych herself up for 
the Yushun Himba (Japanese Oaks). However, 
something is clearly wrong...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later, Air Groove noticed something was 
off with Mejiro Dober and asked if she 
could talk to her to cheer her up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unable to find the right words to say to 
Mejiro Dober now, all you can do is bet on 
Air Groove. Believing in her, you entrust 
Mejiro Dober to her care.
